title: GateDecision
description: A human decision at a mandatory gate. Not effective until materialized as a repository artifact (Constitution v1.1.0, Gate semantics). Silence is never an approval.

outcome.description: TIMED_OUT suspends the run; it never advances it. There is no outcome value meaning 'no response, proceed'.

actorType.description: 'system' is permitted ONLY for TIMED_OUT and for retention-driven abandonment, neither of which is an approval. An agent may never decide a gate at any autonomy setting (FR-ORC-021).

requestedChanges.description: Required and non-empty when outcome is CHANGES_REQUESTED — changes must be enumerated, not implied.

escalationTarget.description: Required when outcome is ESCALATED: what decision exceeds the current owner's authority.

repositoryRecordPath.description: Materialized artifact path. A decision existing only in workflow state or conversation does not satisfy the gate.

disclosedDeadlines.description: Both were shown in the original ask, so the expiry consequence was disclosed rather than discovered (CL-005 addendum).

supersedes.description: Set when replanning voids a prior approval. The prior decision is superseded by reference, never deleted or edited (EC-020).
